maya: Heads up — CI rerank/embeddings job flaky on main after the quantization merge (PR #4287). MRR on devset drops ~3-4% intermittently.
maya: Failed runs: job 1192 / 1205 / 1211 (matrix: python3.9 / cuda12). Logs attached in artifact.
maya: Stack trace snippet shows different ordering for tied scores in scorer: `sorted(results, key=lambda x: x.score, reverse=True)` — might be non-deterministic when scores equal.
jonah: @maya thanks — can you paste a minimal repro (seed + config) ? I suspect floating point non-determinism from q8 kernel but could also be eval runner tie handling.
maya: repro command:
```
PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python -m evals.runner --task rerank --model ./out/q8/model.pt --seed 42 --dataset dev_small --normalize True
```
maya: artifacts show small variance in embeddings due to quantization, but the metric delta seems larger than expected. :thinking:
eva: linking to the eval harness test I wrote — there was an earlier bug where we used `np.argsort` on floats without stable sort; change in numpy version (1.26) changed default behavior. I recommend `np.lexsort` with deterministic tie-breaker.
eva: snippet I propose:
```
# stable ranking: primary by score, secondary by doc_id to break ties
order = np.lexsort((doc_ids, -scores))
```
jonah: that makes sense. Also we should L2-normalize embeddings before cosine in the runner; some q8 kernels introduce tiny norm shifts that amplify when not normalized.
jonah: I'll push a small patch to the runner: add explicit normalization + stable tie-break. I'll also add a unit test that forces equal scores to assert deterministic order.
sam: ci-bot: matrix job 1211 still failing, requeued.
ci-bot: rerun queued: job 1211 -> started (agent: gpu-5)
ops-bot: alert: dashboard regression detector fired on `rerank_mrr` threshold 2.5% (time series id: rerank-main/devset). Logging as incident INC-2025-67.
maya: for visibility — do we want to revert PR #4287 until we confirm metrics are stable? I'm worried customers will see spikes.
eva: don't revert yet — let's land runner fixes first. If we still see >2% instability after fixes + pinned numpy, then revert.
jonah: patch up: PR #4293 opened with runner fixes + test. CI matrix job included normalization, stable sort, and pinned numpy to 1.25 in the test env. cc @eva @maya
maya: running local eval with PR branch now.
maya: local run: MRR variance reduced to ~0.2% across 5 seeds. Looks good. :+1:
ops-bot: INC-2025-67 updated: mitigated by metric-determinism patch. Closing if stable for 24h.
maya: will monitor dashboards and report back. Thanks team! :chart_with_upwards_trend:
